positive_targets: all original legal public messages, successful tools and first Final in a joint-valid whole session; failed requests only remain in history
readiness: report counts of valid original pure D/R sessions within each condition only; do not instantiate training kappa or mix N/E prefixes
reviewer: executing assistant; labels, condition, costs and model identifiers hidden in review packets where feasible; not independent or guaranteed fully blinded
stop: all 48 registrations completed or terminally unavailable; never resample or train
submission_order: replicate ascending; each task N then E; two complete balanced waves
valid_pure_R_yield: joint-valid complete registered pure R signature / 8
